title: Maison Moose | KEY.co
description_expanded: - Maison Moose is surrounded by beautiful, mature pine trees and a gorgeous mountain skyline in Deer Valley, Utah. This decadent residence is the perfect location for a luxurious retreat, no matter the season. The property boasts the true definition of being ski-in/ski-out as the residence is mere steps from the SilverStrike Express lift. If you prefer to ski the terrain at Park City Mountain Resort, you can be on the slopes in under 10 minutes. The hustle and bustle of Main Street, the heart of Park City, is only 3 miles away from the property. Maison Moose is under a mile from Deer Valley's Silver Lake Village where you will find ski shops, 5-star restaurants, and fun bars and entertainment. Tucked into the exclusive Empire Pass neighborhood of Deer Valley, this luxurious Arrowleaf Lodge residence offers the ultimate ski-in/ski-out experience with the Silver Strike lift and run just steps from the private ski locker room. With three beautifully appointed bedrooms and an open-concept layout designed for comfort and connection, the home features a sleek chef’s kitchen, spacious dining for up to 18, and an inviting living area anchored by a cozy fireplace and floor-to-ceiling mountain views. Whether sipping cocoa on the private patio or gathering for a meal after a day on the slopes, every space feels both elegant and effortless.
